newsitem.title: GHANA: Bearish sentiment prevails on Ghana Bourse.
newsitem.headline: Bearish sentiment prevails on Ghana Bourse.

text.p: Despite a slight rise of the All-Share index, last week's bearish sentiment continued in lifeless trade on the Ghana Bourse on Wednesday, its market report showed.
The All-Share index rose just 0.005 point to 384.463, up from 384.458 on Monday. The total shares traded fell to 20,050 compared to its previous 75,330 shares.

The two gainers were consumer products company Unilever, up five cedis to 870 cedis, and Enterprise Insurance Company, up five cedis to 525 cedis. The only loser was Ghana Commercial Bank GCB.GH, down two cedis to 660 cedis.
